title: Casinova Leaderboard Guide: How Rankings Are Calculated
excerpt: The Casinova Gaming leaderboard ranks the top 50 members by total VIP points, highest first. It is one all-time board: there are no daily, weekly or monthly resets and no prize attached to a position. Points come from daily check-ins, the daily spin and referrals.
content:
The Casinova Gaming leaderboard ranks the top 50 members by total VIP points, highest first. It is one all-time board: there are no daily, weekly or monthly resets and no prize attached to a position. Points come from daily check-ins, the daily spin and referrals.

What the leaderboard shows

The leaderboard page is public, so you can read it without logging in. It is a single table with four columns:

  • Rank. Position 1 to 50, ordered by VIP points from highest to lowest.
  • Player. The member's name, partly hidden.
  • Tier. Bronze, Silver, Gold or Platinum.
  • VIP Points. The member's points total.

Only the top 50 accounts are listed. Suspended accounts are left off. The page is rebuilt roughly every two minutes, so a change in your points can take a couple of minutes to appear. If no rankings are available yet, the page shows "Rankings will appear soon" in place of the table.

How rankings are calculated

There is no separate leaderboard score. Your rank is your VIP points total compared with everyone else's. The same number decides your VIP tier, which is why the board also works as a quick way to see how far the next tier is in practice. These are the actions that add points:

ActionVIP points
Daily check-in on the Daily rewards page ("Check in")5 on the first day, 1 more for each consecutive day, up to 11 from day seven
Daily mission: spin the wheel, then "Claim spin reward"5
Cash prize on the daily spin10 points per dollar won, so 10 to 100
Friend signs up with your referral codePoints per referral, shown in your dashboard

The check-in streak follows the calendar day in UTC. Miss a day and the streak starts again at 5 points. The board never resets, and nothing in the program removes points for inactivity.

How your name appears

Names are partly hidden on the board, so a full name or an email address is not displayed. There is no opt-in step: any active account with enough points to reach the top 50 is listed automatically.

What the leaderboard is not

An older version of this guide described things the site does not have. To be clear:

  • No period boards. There is no daily, weekly or monthly board. One all-time table only.
  • No XP. The board counts VIP points. Casinova has no XP or level number; the XP and levels guide explains what exists instead.
  • No prize for placing. Finishing first, or in the top ten, pays nothing extra.
  • No effect on games. Rank does not change the deposit match, the $5 to $500 load range or the redeem rules, and it has no influence on results inside a game.

How rank relates to VIP tiers

Because the board and the tiers use the same number, the tier column tells you roughly where the thresholds sit on the table: Bronze from 0 points, Silver from 500, Gold from 2,000 and Platinum from 5,000. What a tier changes is the number of daily spins you get: 1 at Bronze, 2 at Silver, 3 at Gold and Platinum. The VIP tiers guide covers the tiers, and the public VIP page lists the thresholds. Your own points and the gap to the next tier are on the VIP Status page in your dashboard.

Sensible ways to move up

  1. Check in every day. Open Daily rewards in your dashboard and tap Check in. A full week of consecutive check-ins is 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 points, 56 in total, and every day after that is 11 as long as the streak holds.
  2. Spin, then claim the mission. Take your daily spin, then go back to Daily rewards and tap Claim spin reward for 5 points. A cash prize on the wheel adds 10 points per dollar on top. The daily spin guide lists the prizes.
  3. Refer people who will actually use the site. Each friend who signs up with your code adds VIP points. The referral guide covers where to find the code.

A member who checks in and spins every UTC day earns 91 points in the first week and 16 a day after that, before any spin prizes. At that pace the Silver threshold of 500 points is about 33 days away. Gold and Platinum are long-term totals.

A leaderboard position has no cash value, and none of the point sources involves spending. Keep it that way: rank is a by-product of showing up, not a reason to load a game. If the board, or play in general, starts to feel like pressure, the responsible play page has tools and contacts.

FAQ

Do I need to opt in to appear on the leaderboard?

No. The board lists the 50 active accounts with the most VIP points automatically, with names partly hidden.

Does the leaderboard reset?

No. It is a single all-time ranking by total VIP points. There are no daily, weekly or monthly boards.

Is there a prize for finishing first?

No. Rank itself pays nothing. The practical benefit of points is your VIP tier, which sets how many daily spins you get.

Why am I not on the board?

Only the top 50 accounts by points are shown. Your own points total and the gap to the next tier are on the VIP Status page in your dashboard.

How quickly does the board update?

The page is refreshed about every two minutes, so new points can take a short while to show.

Create your free account and your points start counting from your first check-in.

title: Casinova Gaming: How the Platform Works, End to End
excerpt: Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform that puts one account and one wallet in front of eight third-party game apps, including Juwa, Game Vault and Vegas Sweeps. You deposit by card, load $5 to $500 into a game, and redeem from the game panel once the balance reaches 3x the load. It is not a licensed casino, and availability varies by jurisdiction.
content:
Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform that puts one account and one wallet in front of eight third-party game apps, including Juwa, Game Vault and Vegas Sweeps. You deposit by card, load $5 to $500 into a game, and redeem from the game panel once the balance reaches 3x the load. It is not a licensed casino, and availability varies by jurisdiction.

What "platform" means here

The games themselves are made by outside providers. Each one normally needs its own login and its own way of adding credits. Casinova sits in front of them: you hold one Casinova account, one wallet, and a panel on each game's page where you create a login, load credits, check the balance and submit a redeem. Your deposit history, VIP points and support messages stay in the same account no matter which game you open.

What is inside a Casinova account

  • A wallet in dollars. A Total Deposit balance you load games from, and a Deposit Redeem balance that approved redeems return to.
  • A panel per game. Create the game login, load, check balance and redeem from one screen.
  • A daily spin. A wheel with prizes of $1, $2, $3, $4, $7 or $10, or nothing. Bronze members get 1 spin per 24 hours, Silver 2, Gold and Platinum 3. See the daily spin guide.
  • Daily rewards. A check-in that adds VIP points, with a streak that raises the daily amount.
  • VIP tiers. Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum at 0, 500, 2,000 and 5,000 points. Explained in the VIP tiers guide.
  • Referrals. A personal code. Each friend who signs up with it adds VIP points to your account.
  • A leaderboard. The top 50 members by VIP points, on the public leaderboard page.
  • Chat and Messages. Once you are logged in, the chat is available 24/7 and has an AI Assistant tab and a Real Agent tab. The dashboard also has a Messages inbox.
  • ID verification. An upload page for a government ID, required before any redeem.

How it works, end to end

  1. Create a free account and verify your email.
  2. Deposit by card. Choose one of the amounts shown at checkout and pay. Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal and crypto are not offered. The deposit guide walks through it.
  3. Open a live game and create your game login from the panel on its page. The login appears in the panel when it is ready.
  4. Load credits. Any whole-dollar amount from $5 to $500 per load. The deposit match is applied at this step, to the amount you load. Details in how to load credits.
  5. Play in the provider's app or web player with the login from your panel.
  6. Redeem. Run Check Balance in the panel. When the in-game balance is at least 3x the amount you loaded, submit a redeem from the same panel. You need an approved ID, and staff review every request. See how to redeem.

The money rules in one table

RuleWhat applies
DepositsBy card, in the amounts shown at checkout
Deposit match100% on the first deposit, 50% on the second, none after
When the match is appliedWhen you load a game, on the amount loaded
Load size$5 minimum, $500 maximum, rounded to the nearest dollar
Redeem thresholdIn-game balance of at least 3x the wallet amount loaded, before the match
Redeem cap8x the same amount
Size of one redeem request$5 to $500
Redeem requirementsA Check Balance first, an approved government ID and a staff review

The 3x and 8x figures are measured on your most recent completed load in that game, so a later, smaller load resets the base. The same rules apply to every live game and every VIP tier. There is no payout-time promise: a redeem is finished when the review is finished.

Games you can load now

Eight games are live: Game Vault, Juwa, MR All In One, Cash Machine, Cash Frenzy, Vegas Sweeps, Gameroom and Mafia. Between them they cover slots, keno and fish shooters. If you are unsure where to start, the four-question guide narrows it down.

Six more titles are coming soon and cannot be loaded yet: Orion Stars, Fire Kirin, Panda Master, Vblink, Milky Way and Ultrapanda. They do not appear on the games page, which lists live games only; in the home page lobby their cards are marked Soon. The coming-soon guide suggests the closest live game for each.

What the platform does not do

  • It does not set game outcomes. Results come from each provider's software and are based on chance. Casinova does not publish odds or RTP.
  • It does not use promo codes or give a signup credit. The deposit match is automatic, and the daily spin can add $1 to $10, or nothing, to your wallet.
  • It does not take payment through personal handles. Deposits go through the checkout on the site. Do not send money anywhere else because a message asked you to.
  • It does not claim to be available everywhere. Sweepstakes rules differ by jurisdiction, and checking yours is your responsibility.

Play is for adults 18 and over. Decide what you can afford before you deposit, and use the responsible play page if it stops being fun.

FAQ

Is Casinova Gaming a casino?

No. It is a sweepstakes gaming platform, not a licensed casino. Availability varies by jurisdiction.

How do I deposit?

By card, through the checkout in your dashboard. Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal and crypto are not offered.

Which games are available right now?

Game Vault, Juwa, MR All In One, Cash Machine, Cash Frenzy, Vegas Sweeps, Gameroom and Mafia. Coming-soon games cannot be loaded yet.

What do I need before I can redeem?

A fresh Check Balance, an in-game balance of at least 3x the amount you loaded, and an approved government ID. Staff review each request, and redeems are capped at 8x the load.

Do I need a separate wallet for each game?

No. One Casinova wallet funds every live game. Each game has its own login and balance once you load it.

Create your free account and look around the dashboard before you deposit anything.

content:
The Casinova Gaming site footer links to a Telegram channel at t.me/casinovagaming, but account support does not run through Telegram. Support happens in the chat on the site and the Messages inbox in your dashboard, both of which need a Casinova login. For anything about a deposit, a game login or a redeem, use the Real Agent tab in the chat or the Messages inbox.

What the Telegram link is

The Telegram icon sits with the other social icons in the site footer and opens t.me/casinovagaming. That is the only Telegram address the site itself points to.

Telegram is not connected to your account. Nothing you send there is attached to your wallet, your game panels or your ID status, and you do not need a Telegram account to use Casinova at all.

Where support actually happens

ChannelNeeds a login?Use it for
Chat, Real Agent tabYesDeposits, loads, redeems, ID verification, anything about money
Messages inbox in the dashboardYesThe same, with a written history and attachments
Chat, AI Assistant tabYesGeneral orientation only
Telegram link in the footerNoNot for account support

The chat bubble is visible to visitors, but it asks you to log in before you can start a conversation, so create a free account first. The support page lists live chat along with common questions.

How the chat works

The chat is available 24/7 and has two tabs at the top of the window:

  • AI Assistant. The default tab. It is an automated helper.
  • Real Agent. Tap this tab to hand the conversation to a person. The chat shows a notice that an agent has been notified and will reply in the same window.

For anything about money, meaning a deposit, a load, a balance or a redeem, choose Real Agent or write in the Messages inbox, and rely on what the staff member and your dashboard tell you. The amounts, limits and rules that apply to your account are the ones shown at checkout and in the game panel.

This is also the one real connection between Casinova support and Telegram: when you message support and no agent is online on the site, the team gets an alert on its own internal Telegram so someone can pick the conversation up. You do nothing on Telegram for that to happen, and the reply arrives in the site chat.

The Messages inbox accepts attachments, so you can send a screenshot of what you are seeing. Your conversation history stays in the inbox, which gives you a written record to refer back to.

What to include so the first reply is useful

  1. The game. For example Juwa or Game Vault.
  2. What you did and when. "Loaded $20 at about 3 pm" is far more useful than "my load is missing".
  3. What the panel shows now. Run Check Balance and send a screenshot of the game panel or your deposit history.
  4. What you expected. One sentence is enough.

Many questions are answered faster by a guide than by a queue. For a deposit that has not appeared, read the card deposit guide. For a redeem that will not go through, check ID verification and how to redeem first, because the usual causes are an ID still in review, a balance below 3x the amount loaded, or a Check Balance that has not been run.

Staying safe on Telegram

Telegram makes it easy for anyone to create an account with a familiar name and logo. Treat a direct message that claims to be Casinova with suspicion, and keep these rules:

  • Use the link in the site footer. It opens t.me/casinovagaming. Do not trust a handle sent to you by a stranger.
  • Pay only through the site. Casinova takes deposits through the checkout on the site; do not send money to a personal handle because a message asked you to.
  • Never share your password, a login code or your full card number in any chat.
  • Upload your ID only in the dashboard. The ID verification page is the place for it, not a Telegram chat.
  • Do not enter codes from strangers. Casinova has no promo codes.

The guide to checking whether Casinova is legit covers what else you can verify yourself.

Does VIP tier change support?

The VIP page lists basic support at Bronze, priority support at Silver, 24/7 VIP support at Gold and a dedicated account manager at Platinum. All of it happens through the same site chat and Messages inbox. There is no separate Telegram line for higher tiers. The VIP tiers guide lists the thresholds.

If you are contacting support because play has become stressful or you want a break, say so directly, and see the responsible play page.

FAQ

Is Telegram the way to contact Casinova support?

No. Support runs through the chat on the site and the Messages inbox in your dashboard. The footer links to a Telegram channel, but it is not tied to your account.

Do I need a Telegram account to use Casinova?

No. Everything, including deposits, loads, redeems and support, works on the site without Telegram.

What is the official Casinova Telegram?

t.me/casinovagaming, which is the link behind the Telegram icon in the site footer.

Someone on Telegram asked me to send money to a personal account. Is that Casinova?

Treat it as not Casinova. Deposits go through the checkout on the site. Do not send money, and tell support about it through the Real Agent tab or Messages.

How do I reach a person and not the AI assistant?

Log in, open the chat and tap the Real Agent tab. An agent is notified and replies in the same chat window. You can also write in the Messages inbox.

Create your free account and you will find the chat and Messages in your account from the first login.

title: Casinova Gaming vs Online Casinos: What Is the Difference?
excerpt: Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform, not a licensed online casino. A licensed casino holds a gambling license from a regulator and operates only where that license applies; Casinova holds no casino license, makes no claim about where it is legal, and its availability varies by jurisdiction. In practice the differences you will notice are how you pay, how you redeem and what information is published about the games.
content:
Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform, not a licensed online casino. A licensed casino holds a gambling license from a regulator and operates only where that license applies; Casinova holds no casino license, makes no claim about where it is legal, and its availability varies by jurisdiction. In practice the differences you will notice are how you pay, how you redeem and what information is published about the games.

Quick comparison

Casinova GamingLicensed online casino (in general)
ModelSweepstakes model, no casino licenseGambling license issued by a regulator
Where it operatesVaries by jurisdiction; you must check your ownOnly in places covered by its license
GamesThird-party apps such as Juwa and Game Vault, each with its own loginGames offered inside the casino's own site or app
Paying inBy cardDepends on the operator
Bonus100% match on the first deposit, 50% on the second, none afterDepends on the operator
Getting money outRedeem from the game panel at 3x the load, capped at 8x, with ID and staff reviewWithdrawal under the operator's terms and its regulator's rules
Published odds or RTPNoneDepends on the regulator and the operator
Minimum age18+Set by the regulator

The right-hand column is deliberately general. Licensed casinos differ from one another and from one regulator to the next, and this page is not a guide to any of them.

The model is the real difference

A licensed online casino takes wagers under a license. The regulator that issued it decides where the casino can operate, what checks it must run and how complaints are handled. Casinova does not operate under that framework. It runs under a sweepstakes model, which is a different category, and it does not tell you that the model is permitted where you live. That is for you to confirm before you sign up.

Two posts go deeper on this: what sweepstakes games are and sweepstakes versus real-money gambling. Neither is legal advice, and neither is this page.

How the games differ

On Casinova you do not play inside the Casinova website. You create a login for a third-party game app from the panel on that game's page, load credits into it from your wallet, and play in the provider's app or web player. Eight games are live, including Juwa, Game Vault, Vegas Sweeps and Cash Machine. The formats will look familiar if you have used a casino site: slots, keno and fish shooters. If the shooter format is new to you, start with what a fish table game is.

Each game has its own login and its own balance. You load a game from your Casinova wallet and redeem from that same game's panel.

How the money side differs

  • Deposits are by card. You choose one of the amounts shown at checkout. Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal and crypto are not offered. The card deposit guide shows each step.
  • Balances are in dollars, not coins. There is a Total Deposit balance you load from and a Deposit Redeem balance that approved redeems return to.
  • Loads have fixed limits. $5 minimum and $500 maximum per load, rounded to the nearest dollar.
  • The bonus is tied to deposit order. Your first deposit is matched 100% and your second 50%, on the amount you load into a game. There is nothing after the second, and there are no promo codes.
  • Redeem has a threshold and a cap. Both are measured on the wallet amount you loaded, before the match. A $20 load opens redeem at $60 in the game and caps at $160. The base is your most recent completed load in that game, so a later, smaller load resets it.
  • Every redeem is reviewed. You run Check Balance, submit a request of $5 to $500, and a staff member reviews it. You need an approved government ID. Casinova does not promise a payout time. See how to redeem.

What is not published

Casinova does not publish odds or RTP figures for these apps and does not control how a provider's game decides its results. If you see a payout percentage quoted for Juwa or Game Vault somewhere online, we have not seen one published by the provider. Outcomes are based on chance, and no pattern or strategy makes a result certain. The safety checklist explains what you can and cannot verify about a game.

Which one suits you

This is not a case of one being better. If a regulator's oversight, a formal complaints route and published game information matter most to you, a licensed operator in a place where one is available is the fit, and Casinova is not a substitute for that. If you are specifically looking for app-style games such as Juwa or Game Vault behind one wallet with fixed load and redeem rules, that is what Casinova provides.

Either way, the same habits apply: decide your budget before you deposit, treat the money as spent on entertainment, and stop when it is gone. The responsible play page lists tools and help lines.

FAQ

Is Casinova Gaming a real online casino?

No. It is a sweepstakes gaming platform and does not hold a casino license.

Can I use Casinova where I live?

Availability varies by jurisdiction and Casinova makes no legality claim for any location. Check the rules that apply to you before signing up. Players must be 18 or older.

Do the games publish RTP like some casino games do?

Casinova does not publish odds or RTP for these apps, and we have not seen figures published by the providers.

Is redeeming the same as a casino withdrawal?

Not quite. You redeem from the game panel once the in-game balance is at least 3x the amount you loaded, up to an 8x cap, with an approved ID and a staff review. There is no promised payout time.

How do I pay at Casinova?

By card, through the checkout in your dashboard. Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal and crypto are not offered.

Create your free account and read the deposit and redeem screens yourself before you spend anything.

title: Casinova XP and Levels Explained: VIP Points and Tiers
excerpt: Casinova Gaming does not have XP or numbered levels. Progress is measured in VIP points, and those points place you in one of four tiers: Bronze at 0, Silver at 500, Gold at 2,000 and Platinum at 5,000. Points come from daily check-ins, the daily spin and referrals.
content:
Casinova Gaming does not have XP or numbered levels. Progress is measured in VIP points, and those points place you in one of four tiers: Bronze at 0, Silver at 500, Gold at 2,000 and Platinum at 5,000. Points come from daily check-ins, the daily spin and referrals.

XP versus VIP points

If you searched for a Casinova XP curve or a level chart, there is not one. An earlier version of this page described an XP formula, level milestones and coin bonuses that the site does not have. The only progress number on your account is your VIP points total, and the only "levels" are the four VIP tiers. Everything below describes that system.

The four tiers

TierPoints neededDaily spins
Bronze01
Silver5002
Gold2,0003
Platinum5,0003

Daily spins are per 24 hours. The public VIP page lists the tiers and thresholds. Your own points and the gap to the next tier are on the VIP Status page in your dashboard. The VIP tiers guide goes through the tiers one by one.

Where points come from

ActionVIP points
Daily check-in on the Daily rewards page ("Check in")5 on the first day, 1 more for each consecutive day, up to 11 from day seven
Daily mission: spin the wheel, then "Claim spin reward"5
Cash prize on the daily spin10 points per dollar won, so 10 to 100
Friend signs up with your referral codePoints per referral, shown in your dashboard

A few details behind the table:

  • Check-in streak. The Daily rewards page in your dashboard has a Check in button. Day one pays 5 points, day two 6, and so on up to 11 on day seven and every day after. The day is counted in UTC. Miss one and the streak goes back to 5.
  • Daily mission. After you take your daily spin, return to Daily rewards and tap Claim spin reward for 5 more points. One claim per day.
  • Spin prizes. The wheel pays $1, $2, $3, $4, $7 or $10, or nothing. A cash prize also adds 10 points per dollar, so a $3 result is 30 points. The daily spin guide explains the wheel.
  • Referrals. Each friend who signs up with your code adds VIP points. See the referral guide.

How long does Silver take?

Silver is 500 points. Here is the arithmetic for a member who refers nobody and uses the check-in and the mission only:

  • First seven days of check-ins: 5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 9 + 10 + 11 = 56 points.
  • Seven daily missions: 35 points. First week total: 91.
  • Each day after that: 11 for the check-in plus 5 for the mission, 16 points.

Two ideas in one phrase

"Fish table sweepstakes" joins a game format and a platform model, and it helps to separate them.

  • Fish table is the format. Players share a screen full of moving fish. Each shot costs credits at the bet you choose, and a fish that is caught pays credits back. The name comes from the arcade cabinets built as a table with seats around it. What is a fish table game explains the format on its own.
  • Sweepstakes is the model the platform operates under. It is a different category from a licensed casino. What are sweepstakes games covers the model in plain terms.

One caution on the second point: a sweepstakes model is not the same as being permitted everywhere. Availability varies by jurisdiction, Casinova makes no claim about any location, and checking the rules where you live is up to you.

How a fish table round works

  1. You pick a room, usually sorted by stake.
  2. You set a bet per shot. Higher bets cost more per shot and pay more per catch.
  3. You aim and fire. Small fish generally pay less and larger targets more.
  4. Whether a shot catches a fish is decided by the game's software, not by aim.

That last step is the one people misread. Aiming well stops you wasting shots on empty water, but outcomes are decided by the game's software, not by aim, and Casinova does not control or see how a provider's game decides them. Casinova does not publish odds or RTP for these games, and no timing trick or pattern makes a catch certain. What you do control is the bet per shot and how long you stay, which is why honest advice about fish tables is mostly about pacing.
